programme.desc: 3-time rear wheel drive Gymkhana Grid champion Luke Woodham is defending for a fourth title. His biggest rival Adam Elder is doing everything he can to win.

programme.title: Gymkhana Grid Profiles S1 - "Great 8"
programme.desc: Road to Gymkhana Grid: 100% pure adrenalin! Profiling 8 of the sport’s top drivers, we see into their minds and the mental preparation needed to compete.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Five"
programme.desc: Nik showcases Mercedes-Benz's screen innovation. Mike loves the 2021 Kia Seltos. They both enjoy driving cool cars like the 2021 Corvette Stingray. Nik praises the 2021 Toyota Venza Hybrid.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Six"
programme.desc: Nik explores Range Rover's history, tests the 2021 Volvo XC90 ReCharge hybrid, and rides the 2021 Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat Red Eye with Mike. He's wowed by the 2021 BMW 745e.

programme.title: Our Auto Expert S1 - "Episode Seven"
programme.desc: Nike reviews the innovative 2021 Mercedes-Benz S Class. Mike explores how cities adapt for autonomous vehicles. Nik introduces the 2022 Acura MDX with Amazon Alexa, and the all-new 2022 Kia Carnival.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Crash"
programme.desc: After driver Jon Webster crashes the Flying Kestrel at 148 mph, the team must work out what went wrong and have to decide if the dream of a land speed record is worth risking it all?

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Rebuild"
programme.desc: The Flying Kestrel team regroup at Jon’s workshop as he shows them his new groundbreaking ideas to rebuild the car to give them the best chance at breaking a land speed record.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Test"
programme.desc: The new version of the Flying Kestrel is ready to be put to the test at one of the most state of the art wind tunnels. Has the team done enough to create a record-breaking car?

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "21st Birthday"
programme.desc: Which contestant can get the furthest on 500ml of fuel while maintaining a set race speed? Can Glenn take out top spot and receive the best birthday present he could ask for?

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "Brains and Brawn"
programme.desc: Being a successful motorbike racer takes more than a need for speed. Today the rookies’ brains AND brawn are tested, in skills and points challenges designed to stretch them to the limit.

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S1 - "Throttle Control"
programme.desc: It’s getting to the pointy end of the competition in The Ultimate Rider - and failure this week will could bring embarrassment as well as pain.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The 3.5"
programme.desc: A rare 1971 Mercedes Benz 280 SE 3.5 Coupe gets restored to its original specifications.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "Pinky"
programme.desc: A pink, air-cooled, 1973 Porsche 911 RS is upgraded with a custom built engine, new paint, and new wheels and tires.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "Benzilla"
programme.desc: A slow and outdated 1959 Mercedes Benz 180 D is modified with a bargain budget to include new wheels and an American V8 muscle motor.

programme.title: Inside Moto S1 - "Race Against or Share With?"
programme.desc: We discover the relationship between Brad and Darryn Binder, 2 brothers who race against each other on motorcycle tracks around the world.

programme.title: Supercar Blondie: Living the Dream S1 - "Supercar Blondie: Living the Dream"
programme.desc: Alex Hirschi started her own vlog reviewing the world’s most exclusive and expensive supercars and her meteoric rise has seen her gain millions of followers and her very own TV Series.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S12 - "Just the Way You Are"
programme.desc: One of eight ever made, the 1971 In Violet Plymouth 'Cuda 383 is finished and ready for delivery; the crew reflects on the journey the car has taken before the final touches are put on.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S12 - "Bad to the Bone"
programme.desc: In a build too big for just one episode, the tribute 1958 Plymouth Fury, famously known as Christine, not only gets a full restoration with OE attention to detail, but it also gets a brand-new, modern, third-generation engine.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz S12 - "Beast of Burden"
programme.desc: With the SEMA Show 2019 just days away, the team scrambles to finish the assembly of the tribute "Christine." Mark begins to question how complete the car will be when it ships to the convention center in Las Vegas, Nevada.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "The Outsider"
programme.desc: Wayland Campbell and Levi Shirley go head to head leading to the championship but there is an outsider Randy Slawson, 2 time champion to never under-estimate.

programme.title: King of the Hammers: The Ultra4 Saga S1 - "The Showdown"
programme.desc: Leaders Wayland Campbell and Levi Shirley push each other to their limits while other top drivers show just how fast 4x4 off road racing has become.

programme.title: Supercar Showdown S2 - "Braking Challenge"
programme.desc: It’s week three and the contestants are preparing for a new round of challenges.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Norway"
programme.desc: An Irish MTB pro rider discovers and rides the most amazing trails that Norway has to offer from the mountains to the ocean.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Alaska"
programme.desc: We follow one of the best MTB riders and trail-builders on the planet during a trip in Alaska, one of the most remote and wild places in the world.

programme.title: MTB Heroes S3 - "Brazil"
programme.desc: The World’s best Brazilian rider opens the doors to his house to show how it all started and brings us to Mexico for the most famous urban race in the world.

programme.title: The Ride Life with Sung Kang S1 - "Chicago"
programme.desc: Sung braves the ice-cold winter and reputation as one of the US's crime capitals to uncover the best of Chicago's car culture. He finds there's much more to the windy city than the Blues Mobile. Car nuts are giving the big city a small town heart.

programme.title: The Ride Life with Sung Kang S1 - "Los Angeles"

programme.title: The Ride Life with Sung Kang S1 - "United Kingdom"

programme.title: The Ultimate Rider S2 - "Dirt Vs Road"
programme.desc: The Ultimate Rider will need to master both dirt and road surfaces to claim top spot. And, surprise eliminations could end their dream at any time. Could someone go home after just one day?

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The Track T"

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The 300"

An expectant father is arrested after a gin-fueled rampage at his parent's house and misses the birth of his first child. A woman arrested for selling fake designer purses as real ones says she didn’t know it was a crime.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: An uncooperative inmate complicates things. A man charged with DUI complains about the prison food. A security guard arrested for robbery fears that her dream job with Homeland Security is gone.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: Chaos surrounds a routine medical screening of an inmate. In the prison phone center, a smoking pipe is discovered and a mystery ensues. A pregnant woman is investigated over potential sex crimes.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: An inmate swallows a stash of drugs and then comes down with a case of the munchies. A 72-year-old offers an unusual excuse for dealing drugs to teens at a mall, and a woman charged with assaulting a landlord fakes being sick to get out of jail.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A strip search reveals a male inmate in women's lingerie. A couple of puppy thieves get amorous in the bathroom, and a pregnant woman is arrested for solicitation.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: Three inmates start brawling inside the drunk tank. One man must wear a mask so that officers can avoid his rain of spit. A young woman fails to take jail seriously and behaves provocatively.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: The night of the Mayweather-Pacquiao fight a woman pummels a nightclub security guard for an unusual reason. A man who claims to have served in the military confronts a Lieutenant and threatens fellow detainees in the holding cell. A “Pac-man” fan has a spat with his Mayweather-backing wife.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A violent ruckus ensues after a man is placed in jail. Secret prison communication methods are explored and examined. Later, deputies cautiously extract a disruptive man while his wife is held nearby.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A vice unit interrogates several individuals accused of sex crimes. Suicidal threats provoke a high-stakes situation within cell walls. Unable to raise bail, a woman is incarcerated for several days.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: An intoxicated inmate escapes his restraints. A young woman denies she abused her mother, and a guard removes an inmate who is causing a disturbance.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A man arrested on drug warrants is upset about the BBQ brisket he left on the grill. An intoxicated ladies' man flirts with the jail staff and an inmate finds it funny that he sold tree leaves as pot to an undercover officer. Brother turns on brother when a good deed gets mixed with alcohol. A man caught panhandling believes officers should arrest hardened criminals instead of him.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: Over the course of a single shift, officers are forced to go toe to toe with a hotheaded inmate refusing to change cells without a fight and then must deal with the whims of a homeless man who demands room service and an upgraded jail cell.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A woman is charged with possession of a controlled substance. A woman denies assaulting her husband, and two aggressive cousins threaten police and end up in isolation.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A woman refuses to wear jail-issued clothing. A man tells his tearful tale to officers, and a chatty inebriated woman is placed in isolation.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: Uncooperative and agitated, a man complains officers are violating his rights. A “443” call is issued, and a deputy desperately needs help. Outside the cell block, there’s knockouts and bloody noses.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: A secret stash is uncovered during a search at a suspect's property. Two rowdy inmates don't quite hit it off when they invade each other's personal space, and a jaywalker experiences problems keeping his pants from falling down.

programme.title: Jail
programme.desc: In Sarasota, FL a man is sent to intake for indecent exposure. In Spokane, WA a man threatening bodily harm to himself is placed in a restraining chair. In Salt Lake City, UT an intoxicated woman fades in and out of coherency. In Portland, OR an amputee is detained for dodging the subway toll.

programme.title: Ach.Samay Sagar ji Maharaj Pravachan
आचार्य समय सागर जी महाराज प्रवचन
ஆச்சார்யா சமய் சாகர் ஜி மகாராஜ் பிரவச்சன்
ఆచార్య సమయ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: A revered religious leader offers thoughtful discourses on ethical living, non-violence and the core tenets of Jainism, motivating devotees to cultivate awareness and spiritual understanding.
एक प्रतिष्ठित धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक नैतिक जीवन, अहिंसा और जैन धर्म के मूल सिद्धांतों पर विचारपूर्ण प्रवचन देते हैं, तथा भक्तों को जागरूकता और आध्यात्मिक समझ विकसित करने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।
ఒక గౌరవనీయమైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు నైతిక జీవనం, అహింస, జైనమతంలోని ప్రధాన సిద్ధాంతాలపై ఆలోచనాత్మక ఉపన్యాసాలు ఇస్తారు.

programme.title: Shanka Samadhan Praman Sagar ji Maharaj
शंका समाधान प्रमाण सागर जी महाराज
ஷங்கா சமாதான் ப்ரமான் சாகர் ஜி மஹாராஜ்
శంక సమాధాన్ ప్రమాణ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్
programme.desc: Praman Sagar Ji Maharaj provides answers to the various doubts and queries posed by the devotees during a religious gathering.
प्रसिद्ध धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक प्रमाण सागर जी महाराज एक सभा के दौरान भक्तों द्वारा पूछे गए विभिन्न संदेहों और प्रश्नों के उत्तर प्रदान करते हैं।
ప్రమాణ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్, ఆధ్యాత్మిక సమావేశంలో భక్తులు అడిగే వివిధ సందేహాలు, ఆలోచనలకు సమాధానం అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: Jigyasa Samadhan Sudha sagar ji maharaj
जिज्ञासा समाधान सुधा सागर जी महाराज
ஜிக்யாசா சமாதான் சுதா சாகர் ஜி மஹாராஜ்
జిజ్ఞాస సమాధాన్ సుధా సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్
programme.desc: A spiritual leader, Sudha Sagar Ji Maharaj, conducts a religious discourse on the teachings of Jainism and encourages devotees to follow in the path of righteousness.
आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक सुधा सागर जी महाराज जैन धर्म की शिक्षाओं पर धार्मिक प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों को धर्म के मार्ग पर चलने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు సుధా సాగర్ జీ మహరాజ్ జైనమత బోధనల గురించి ఉపన్యాసమిచ్చి, భక్తులను ధర్మ మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని కోరతారు.

programme.title: Santvani-Sudha Sagar JI Mangal Pravachan
संतवाणी-सुधा सागर जी मंगल प्रवचन
சந்த்வாணி-சுதா சாகர் ஜி மங்கள் ப்ரவச்சன்
సాంత్వని-సుధా సాగర్ జీ మంగళ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: Sudha Sagar Ji delivers a religious discourse on the teachings of Jainism, encouraging the followers to follow the path of righteousness for a better life.
सुधा सागर जी जैन धर्म की शिक्षाओं पर धार्मिक प्रवचन देते हैं, तथा अनुयायियों को बेहतर जीवन के लिए धार्मिकता के मार्ग पर चलने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।
సుధా సాగర్ జీ జైనమత బోధనలపై ప్రసంగం అందించి, మెరుగైన జీవితం కోసం ధర్మ మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: Inhouse Content
इन्हाउस कंटेन्ट
இன்ஹவுஸ் கன்டென்ட்
ఇన్‌హౌస్ కంటెంట్
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.
टेलीविज़न के एक से बढ़कर एक कार्यक्रमों को प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: Namokar Jaap Mantra
नामोकार जाप मंत्र
நமோகர் ஜாப் மந்த்ரா
నమోకర్ జప్ మంత్ర
programme.desc: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the importance and benefits of the 'namokar mantra' in Jainism, guiding devotees on a spiritual journey.
एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, जैन धर्म में 'नमोकार मंत्र' के महत्व और लाभों पर प्रवचन देते हैं, तथा भक्तों को आध्यात्मिक मार्ग का मार्गदर्शन देते हैं।
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు జైనమతంలో 'నమోకర్ మంత్రం' ప్రాముఖ్యత, ప్రయోజనాలపై ఉపన్యాసం చేస్తూ, భక్తులకు మార్గనిర్దేశం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: Pravachan Dharm Dhavni
प्रवचन धर्म ध्वनि
பிரவச்சன் தர்ம் தவ்னி
ప్రవచన్ ధర్మ ధ్వని
programme.desc: A religious leader elaborates on the teachings of Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality and devotion.
एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर विस्तार से प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता और भक्ति का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు భగవంతుని బోధనలను పంచుకుంటూ, అనుచరులను ఆధ్యాత్మికత, భక్తి మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

జైన దేవాలయంలో మహావీర్ స్వామిని ఆరాధిస్తూ ఆధ్యాత్మిక శ్లోకాలతో పండితులు నిర్వహించే ఆచార వ్యవహారాలలో భక్తులు పాల్గొంటారు.

programme.title: Santvani- Ach.Samay Sagar ji Maharaj Pravachan
सांत्वनी- आचार्य समय सागर जी महाराज प्रवचन
சந்த்வாணி- ஆச்சார்ய சமய் சாகர் ஜி மஹாராஜ் பிரவச்சன்
సంత్వాణి- ఆచార్య సమయ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: A revered religious leader enlightens viewers with discourses on Jain principles, interpreting sacred texts to inspire righteousness and a compassionate way of life.
एक प्रतिष्ठित धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक जैन सिद्धांतों पर प्रवचनों के साथ दर्शकों को ज्ञान देते हैं और पवित्र ग्रंथों पर व्याख्यान देते हुए धार्मिकता और दयालु जीवन जीने की प्रेरणा देते हैं।
గౌరవనీయమైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు జైన సూత్రాలపై ఉపన్యాసాలతో ప్రేక్షకులను జ్ఞానోదయం చేస్తూ, పవిత్ర గ్రంథాలను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Santvani- Vasunandi Ji Maharaj Pravachan
संतवाणी - वसुनंदी जी महाराज प्रवचन
சந்த்வாணி- வசுநந்தி ஜி மஹாராஜ் ப்ரவச்சன்
సంత్వాణి- వసునంది జీ మహారాజ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: A religious leader elaborates on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to follow the path of spirituality.
धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वरीय शिक्षाओं पर प्रवचन देते हैं और अपने भक्तों को आध्यात्मिक यात्रा पर आगे बढ़ने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు భగవంతుని బోధనల గురించి వివరించి, అనుచరులను ఆధ్యాత్మిక మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: Santvani- Praman Sagar ji Maharaj Pravachan
संतवाणी- प्रमाण सागर जी महाराज प्रवचन
சந்த்வாணி- ப்ரமான் சாகர் ஜி மஹாராஜ் ப்ரவச்சன்
సాంత్వాని- ప్రమాణ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: Muni Shri Praman Sagar Ji Maharaj solves the doubts of the common man scientifically through daily problem-solving and discourses.
मुनि श्री प्रमाण सागर जी महाराज दैनिक समस्या के समाधान और प्रवचनों के माध्यम से आम आदमी की शंकाओं का वैज्ञानिक तरीके से समाधान करते हैं।
శ్రీ ప్రమాణ్ సాగర్ జీ రోజువారీ సమావేశాలు మరియు చర్చల ద్వారా ప్రజల సందేహాలను శాస్త్రీయంగా పరిష్కరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Namokar Jaap Mantra
नामोकार जाप मंत्र
நமோகர் ஜாப் மந்த்ரா
నమోకర్ జప్ మంత్ర
programme.desc: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the importance and benefits of the 'namokar mantra' in Jainism, guiding devotees on a spiritual journey.
एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, जैन धर्म में 'नमोकार मंत्र' के महत्व और लाभों पर प्रवचन देते हैं, तथा भक्तों को आध्यात्मिक मार्ग का मार्गदर्शन देते हैं।
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు జైనమతంలో 'నమోకర్ మంత్రం' ప్రాముఖ్యత, ప్రయోజనాలపై ఉపన్యాసం చేస్తూ, భక్తులకు మార్గనిర్దేశం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: Santvani- Durlabh Sagar ji Maharaj Pravachan

సంత్ వాణి- దుర్లభ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: Durlabh Sagar Ji Maharaj delivers a discourse based on the sacred scriptures and urges the devotees to follow the path of righteousness.
दुर्लभ सागर जी महाराज पवित्र शास्त्रों पर आधारित प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों को धर्म के मार्ग पर चलने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।
దుర్లభ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్ పవిత్ర గ్రంథాల ఆధారంగా ఉపన్యాసం ఇస్తూ, ధర్మమార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని భక్తులను ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: JFC- Jain Focus News
जेएफ़सी-जैन फोकस न्यूज़
ஜெ‌எஃப்‌சி- ஜெய்ன் ஃபோகஸ் நியூஸ்
జేఎఫ్‌సీ - జైన్ ఫోకస్ న్యూస్
programme.desc: The host presents the latest information and developments about various Jain leaders, religious events and festivals from different parts of the country.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता देश के विभिन्न हिस्सों से विभिन्न जैन गुरुओं, धार्मिक आयोजनों और त्यौहारों के बारे में नवीनतम जानकारी देते हैं।
వ్యాఖ్యాత దేశంలోని వివిధ ప్రాంతాల జైన గురువుల గురించి, ఆధ్యాత్మిక కార్యక్రమాలు, పండుగల గురించి తాజా సమాచారం అందిస్తారు.

ஷங்கா சமாதான் ப்ரமான் சாகர் ஜி மஹாராஜ்
శంక సమాధాన్ ప్రమాణ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్
programme.desc: Praman Sagar Ji Maharaj provides answers to the various doubts and queries posed by the devotees during a religious gathering.
प्रसिद्ध धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक प्रमाण सागर जी महाराज एक सभा के दौरान भक्तों द्वारा पूछे गए विभिन्न संदेहों और प्रश्नों के उत्तर प्रदान करते हैं।
ప్రమాణ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్, ఆధ్యాత్మిక సమావేశంలో భక్తులు అడిగే వివిధ సందేహాలు, ఆలోచనలకు సమాధానం అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: Jigyasa Samadhan Sudha sagar ji maharaj
जिज्ञासा समाधान सुधा सागर जी महाराज
ஜிக்யாசா சமாதான் சுதா சாகர் ஜி மஹாராஜ்
జిజ్ఞాస సమాధాన్ సుధా సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్
programme.desc: A spiritual leader, Sudha Sagar Ji Maharaj, conducts a religious discourse on the teachings of Jainism and encourages devotees to follow in the path of righteousness.
आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक सुधा सागर जी महाराज जैन धर्म की शिक्षाओं पर धार्मिक प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों को धर्म के मार्ग पर चलने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు సుధా సాగర్ జీ మహరాజ్ జైనమత బోధనల గురించి ఉపన్యాసమిచ్చి, భక్తులను ధర్మ మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని కోరతారు.

programme.title: Santvani-Sudha Sagar JI Mangal Pravachan
संतवाणी-सुधा सागर जी मंगल प्रवचन
சந்த்வாணி-சுதா சாகர் ஜி மங்கள் ப்ரவச்சன்
సాంత్వని-సుధా సాగర్ జీ మంగళ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: Sudha Sagar Ji delivers a religious discourse on the teachings of Jainism, encouraging the followers to follow the path of righteousness for a better life.
सुधा सागर जी जैन धर्म की शिक्षाओं पर धार्मिक प्रवचन देते हैं, तथा अनुयायियों को बेहतर जीवन के लिए धार्मिकता के मार्ग पर चलने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।
సుధా సాగర్ జీ జైనమత బోధనలపై ప్రసంగం అందించి, మెరుగైన జీవితం కోసం ధర్మ మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: Inhouse Content
इन्हाउस कंटेन्ट
இன்ஹவுஸ் கன்டென்ட்
ఇన్‌హౌస్ కంటెంట్
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.
टेलीविज़न के एक से बढ़कर एक कार्यक्रमों को प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: Namokar Jaap Mantra
नामोकार जाप मंत्र
நமோகர் ஜாப் மந்த்ரா
నమోకర్ జప్ మంత్ర
programme.desc: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the importance and benefits of the 'namokar mantra' in Jainism, guiding devotees on a spiritual journey.
एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, जैन धर्म में 'नमोकार मंत्र' के महत्व और लाभों पर प्रवचन देते हैं, तथा भक्तों को आध्यात्मिक मार्ग का मार्गदर्शन देते हैं।
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు జైనమతంలో 'నమోకర్ మంత్రం' ప్రాముఖ్యత, ప్రయోజనాలపై ఉపన్యాసం చేస్తూ, భక్తులకు మార్గనిర్దేశం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: Pravachan Dharm Dhavni
प्रवचन धर्म ध्वनि
பிரவச்சன் தர்ம் தவ்னி
ప్రవచన్ ధర్మ ధ్వని
programme.desc: A religious leader elaborates on the teachings of Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality and devotion.
एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर विस्तार से प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता और भक्ति का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు భగవంతుని బోధనలను పంచుకుంటూ, అనుచరులను ఆధ్యాత్మికత, భక్తి మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: Abhishek Shantidhara
अभिषेक शांतिधारा
அபிஷேக் ஷாந்திதாரா
అభిషేక్ శాంతిధర
programme.desc: A spiritual guide offers an illuminating sermon as worshippers congregate to observe a sacred ceremony, seeking divine favour from the Almighty.
एक आध्यात्मिक मार्गदर्शक एक ज्ञानवर्धक उपदेश देते हैं जबकि श्रद्धालु एक पवित्र समारोह में भाग लेने के लिए इकट्ठा होते हैं, तथा ईश्वर ईश्वर से दिव्य अनुग्रह की कामना करते हैं।
జైన దేవాలయంలో మహావీర్ స్వామిని ఆరాధిస్తూ ఆధ్యాత్మిక శ్లోకాలతో పండితులు నిర్వహించే ఆచార వ్యవహారాలలో భక్తులు పాల్గొంటారు.

programme.title: Santvani- Ach.Samay Sagar ji Maharaj Pravachan
सांत्वनी- आचार्य समय सागर जी महाराज प्रवचन
சந்த்வாணி- ஆச்சார்ய சமய் சாகர் ஜி மஹாராஜ் பிரவச்சன்
సంత్వాణి- ఆచార్య సమయ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: A revered religious leader enlightens viewers with discourses on Jain principles, interpreting sacred texts to inspire righteousness and a compassionate way of life.
एक प्रतिष्ठित धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक जैन सिद्धांतों पर प्रवचनों के साथ दर्शकों को ज्ञान देते हैं और पवित्र ग्रंथों पर व्याख्यान देते हुए धार्मिकता और दयालु जीवन जीने की प्रेरणा देते हैं।
గౌరవనీయమైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు జైన సూత్రాలపై ఉపన్యాసాలతో ప్రేక్షకులను జ్ఞానోదయం చేస్తూ, పవిత్ర గ్రంథాలను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Santvani- Vasunandi Ji Maharaj Pravachan
संतवाणी - वसुनंदी जी महाराज प्रवचन
சந்த்வாணி- வசுநந்தி ஜி மஹாராஜ் ப்ரவச்சன்
సంత్వాణి- వసునంది జీ మహారాజ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: A religious leader elaborates on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to follow the path of spirituality.
धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वरीय शिक्षाओं पर प्रवचन देते हैं और अपने भक्तों को आध्यात्मिक यात्रा पर आगे बढ़ने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు భగవంతుని బోధనల గురించి వివరించి, అనుచరులను ఆధ్యాత్మిక మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: Santvani- Praman Sagar ji Maharaj Pravachan
संतवाणी- प्रमाण सागर जी महाराज प्रवचन
சந்த்வாணி- ப்ரமான் சாகர் ஜி மஹாராஜ் ப்ரவச்சன்
సాంత్వాని- ప్రమాణ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: Muni Shri Praman Sagar Ji Maharaj solves the doubts of the common man scientifically through daily problem-solving and discourses.
मुनि श्री प्रमाण सागर जी महाराज दैनिक समस्या के समाधान और प्रवचनों के माध्यम से आम आदमी की शंकाओं का वैज्ञानिक तरीके से समाधान करते हैं।
శ్రీ ప్రమాణ్ సాగర్ జీ రోజువారీ సమావేశాలు మరియు చర్చల ద్వారా ప్రజల సందేహాలను శాస్త్రీయంగా పరిష్కరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Namokar Jaap Mantra
नामोकार जाप मंत्र
நமோகர் ஜாப் மந்த்ரா
నమోకర్ జప్ మంత్ర
programme.desc: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the importance and benefits of the 'namokar mantra' in Jainism, guiding devotees on a spiritual journey.
एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, जैन धर्म में 'नमोकार मंत्र' के महत्व और लाभों पर प्रवचन देते हैं, तथा भक्तों को आध्यात्मिक मार्ग का मार्गदर्शन देते हैं।
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు జైనమతంలో 'నమోకర్ మంత్రం' ప్రాముఖ్యత, ప్రయోజనాలపై ఉపన్యాసం చేస్తూ, భక్తులకు మార్గనిర్దేశం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: Santvani- Durlabh Sagar ji Maharaj Pravachan
संतवाणी-दुर्लभ सागर जी महाराज प्रवचन
சந்த்வனி- துர்லப் சாகர் ஜி மஹாராஜ் ப்ரவசன்
సంత్ వాణి- దుర్లభ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: Durlabh Sagar Ji Maharaj delivers a discourse based on the sacred scriptures and urges the devotees to follow the path of righteousness.
दुर्लभ सागर जी महाराज पवित्र शास्त्रों पर आधारित प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों को धर्म के मार्ग पर चलने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।
దుర్లభ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్ పవిత్ర గ్రంథాల ఆధారంగా ఉపన్యాసం ఇస్తూ, ధర్మమార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని భక్తులను ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: JFC- Jain Focus News
जेएफ़सी-जैन फोकस न्यूज़
ஜெ‌எஃப்‌சி- ஜெய்ன் ஃபோகஸ் நியூஸ்
జేఎఫ్‌సీ - జైన్ ఫోకస్ న్యూస్

प्रसिद्ध धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक प्रमाण सागर जी महाराज एक सभा के दौरान भक्तों द्वारा पूछे गए विभिन्न संदेहों और प्रश्नों के उत्तर प्रदान करते हैं।
ప్రమాణ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్, ఆధ్యాత్మిక సమావేశంలో భక్తులు అడిగే వివిధ సందేహాలు, ఆలోచనలకు సమాధానం అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: JFC- Jain Focus News
जेएफ़सी-जैन फोकस न्यूज़
ஜெ‌எஃப்‌சி- ஜெய்ன் ஃபோகஸ் நியூஸ்
జేఎఫ్‌సీ - జైన్ ఫోకస్ న్యూస్
programme.desc: The host presents the latest information and developments about various Jain leaders, religious events and festivals from different parts of the country.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता देश के विभिन्न हिस्सों से विभिन्न जैन गुरुओं, धार्मिक आयोजनों और त्यौहारों के बारे में नवीनतम जानकारी देते हैं।
వ్యాఖ్యాత దేశంలోని వివిధ ప్రాంతాల జైన గురువుల గురించి, ఆధ్యాత్మిక కార్యక్రమాలు, పండుగల గురించి తాజా సమాచారం అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: Praman Sagar ji Maharaj Pravachan
प्रमाण सागर जी महाराज प्रवचन
பிரமான் சாகர் ஜி மஹாராஜ் பிரவச்சன்
ప్రమాణ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: Praman Sagar Ji Maharaj delivers a discourse based on the sacred scriptures and urges the devotees to follow the path of righteousness.
प्रमाण सागर जी महाराज पवित्र धार्मिक शास्त्रों पर आधारित प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों से धर्म के मार्ग पर चलने का आग्रह करते हैं।
ప్రమాణ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్ పవిత్ర గ్రంథాల ఆధారంగా ఉపన్యాసం అందించి, భక్తులను ధర్మ మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని కోరతారు.

programme.title: Ach.Samay Sagar ji Maharaj Pravachan
आचार्य समय सागर जी महाराज प्रवचन
ஆச்சார்யா சமய் சாகர் ஜி மகாராஜ் பிரவச்சன்
ఆచార్య సమయ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: A revered religious leader offers thoughtful discourses on ethical living, non-violence and the core tenets of Jainism, motivating devotees to cultivate awareness and spiritual understanding.
एक प्रतिष्ठित धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक नैतिक जीवन, अहिंसा और जैन धर्म के मूल सिद्धांतों पर विचारपूर्ण प्रवचन देते हैं, तथा भक्तों को जागरूकता और आध्यात्मिक समझ विकसित करने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।
ఒక గౌరవనీయమైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు నైతిక జీవనం, అహింస, జైనమతంలోని ప్రధాన సిద్ధాంతాలపై ఆలోచనాత్మక ఉపన్యాసాలు ఇస్తారు.

programme.title: Shanka Samadhan Praman Sagar ji Maharaj
शंका समाधान प्रमाण सागर जी महाराज
ஷங்கா சமாதான் ப்ரமான் சாகர் ஜி மஹாராஜ்
శంక సమాధాన్ ప్రమాణ్ సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్
programme.desc: Praman Sagar Ji Maharaj provides answers to the various doubts and queries posed by the devotees during a religious gathering.

programme.title: Jigyasa Samadhan Sudha sagar ji maharaj
जिज्ञासा समाधान सुधा सागर जी महाराज
ஜிக்யாசா சமாதான் சுதா சாகர் ஜி மஹாராஜ்
జిజ్ఞాస సమాధాన్ సుధా సాగర్ జీ మహారాజ్
programme.desc: A spiritual leader, Sudha Sagar Ji Maharaj, conducts a religious discourse on the teachings of Jainism and encourages devotees to follow in the path of righteousness.
आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक सुधा सागर जी महाराज जैन धर्म की शिक्षाओं पर धार्मिक प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों को धर्म के मार्ग पर चलने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు సుధా సాగర్ జీ మహరాజ్ జైనమత బోధనల గురించి ఉపన్యాసమిచ్చి, భక్తులను ధర్మ మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని కోరతారు.

programme.title: Santvani-Sudha Sagar JI Mangal Pravachan
संतवाणी-सुधा सागर जी मंगल प्रवचन
சந்த்வாணி-சுதா சாகர் ஜி மங்கள் ப்ரவச்சன்
సాంత్వని-సుధా సాగర్ జీ మంగళ్ ప్రవచన్
programme.desc: Sudha Sagar Ji delivers a religious discourse on the teachings of Jainism, encouraging the followers to follow the path of righteousness for a better life.
सुधा सागर जी जैन धर्म की शिक्षाओं पर धार्मिक प्रवचन देते हैं, तथा अनुयायियों को बेहतर जीवन के लिए धार्मिकता के मार्ग पर चलने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।
సుధా సాగర్ జీ జైనమత బోధనలపై ప్రసంగం అందించి, మెరుగైన జీవితం కోసం ధర్మ మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: Inhouse Content
इन्हाउस कंटेन्ट
இன்ஹவுஸ் கன்டென்ட்
ఇన్‌హౌస్ కంటెంట్
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.
टेलीविज़न के एक से बढ़कर एक कार्यक्रमों को प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: Namokar Jaap Mantra
नामोकार जाप मंत्र
நமோகர் ஜாப் மந்த்ரா
నమోకర్ జప్ మంత్ర
programme.desc: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the importance and benefits of the 'namokar mantra' in Jainism, guiding devotees on a spiritual journey.
एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, जैन धर्म में 'नमोकार मंत्र' के महत्व और लाभों पर प्रवचन देते हैं, तथा भक्तों को आध्यात्मिक मार्ग का मार्गदर्शन देते हैं।
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు జైనమతంలో 'నమోకర్ మంత్రం' ప్రాముఖ్యత, ప్రయోజనాలపై ఉపన్యాసం చేస్తూ, భక్తులకు మార్గనిర్దేశం చేస్తారు.

programme.title: Pravachan Dharm Dhavni
प्रवचन धर्म ध्वनि
பிரவச்சன் தர்ம் தவ்னி
ప్రవచన్ ధర్మ ధ్వని
programme.desc: A religious leader elaborates on the teachings of Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality and devotion.
एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर विस्तार से प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता और भक्ति का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।
ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు భగవంతుని బోధనలను పంచుకుంటూ, అనుచరులను ఆధ్యాత్మికత, భక్తి మార్గాన్ని అనుసరించమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: Abhishek Shantidhara
अभिषेक शांतिधारा
அபிஷேக் ஷாந்திதாரா
అభిషేక్ శాంతిధర
programme.desc: A spiritual guide offers an illuminating sermon as worshippers congregate to observe a sacred ceremony, seeking divine favour from the Almighty.
एक आध्यात्मिक मार्गदर्शक एक ज्ञानवर्धक उपदेश देते हैं जबकि श्रद्धालु एक पवित्र समारोह में भाग लेने के लिए इकट्ठा होते हैं, तथा ईश्वर ईश्वर से दिव्य अनुग्रह की कामना करते हैं।
జైన దేవాలయంలో మహావీర్ స్వామిని ఆరాధిస్తూ ఆధ్యాత్మిక శ్లోకాలతో పండితులు నిర్వహించే ఆచార వ్యవహారాలలో భక్తులు పాల్గొంటారు.

programme.desc: A revered religious leader enlightens viewers with discourses on Jain principles, interpreting sacred texts to inspire righteousness and a compassionate way of life.
एक प्रतिष्ठित धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक जैन सिद्धांतों पर प्रवचनों के साथ दर्शकों को ज्ञान देते हैं और पवित्र ग्रंथों पर व्याख्यान देते हुए धार्मिकता और दयालु जीवन जीने की प्रेरणा देते हैं।
గౌరవనీయమైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువు జైన సూత్రాలపై ఉపన్యాసాలతో ప్రేక్షకులను జ్ఞానోదయం చేస్తూ, పవిత్ర గ్రంథాలను వివరిస్తారు.

జంగిల్ బుక్
programme.desc: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli.
एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।

programme.title: Super Bheem
सूपर भीम
சூப்பர் பீம்
సూపర్ భీమ్
सुपर भीम
programme.desc: Super-powered Bheem explores the world outside his village with his friends while helping those in need and righting wrongs.
महाशक्तिशाली भीम अपने दोस्तों के साथ गाँव के बाहर की दुनिया की पड़ताल करता है साथ ही जरूरतमंदों की मदद करते हुए गलत कामों को सही करता है।
நண்பர்களுடன் கிராமத்திற்கு வெளியே உள்ளதை ஆராய்ந்துகொண்டே, மற்றவர்களுக்கு உதவி,தவறுகளையும் சரிசெய்யும் சூப்பர்-பவர் பீம்.
భీమ్, తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి ఊరి బయటి ప్రపంచ అన్వేషణలో భాగంగా, అవసరమైన వారికి సహాయం చేస్తూ తప్పులు సరిదిద్దుతాడు.
शक्तिशाली भीम, आपल्या मित्रांसोबत गावाबाहेरील जगाचा शोध घेतो, गरजू लोकांना मदत करतो आणि अन्यायावर मात करतो.

programme.title: Thicker the Berry the Sweeter the Juice 2
programme.desc: Rising Celebrity News Reporter, Cherish has old flames and new loves collide when her past with her ex-Khalil returns, alongside the return of Caine, who threatens everything she’s built. Will She choose true love or stay the course for her career?

programme.title: Rhythm and Revenge
programme.desc: After losing her parents, Journi, a talented but troubled teenager, moves in with her aunt and cousin for a fresh start. As she navigates the pressures of competitive dance, strange accidents begin to occur around her. Suspicion grows, but Journi always seems one step ahead, charming her way out of trouble. However, when the truth starts to unravel, danger lurks closer than anyone could have imagined.

programme.title: Glitter and Grime
programme.desc: Four friends under dire financial circumstance agree to dance at an amateur night in a local strip club. Drawn into the fast money and invigorating lifestyle, they dive deeper into the dark world of dancing, but fast money comes at a dark price.

programme.title: Don't Miss the Bus
programme.desc: Sierra, a single mother hustles in order to survive with long shifts and grunt work. Her faith is pinned on lottery tickets and men who exploit her vulnerability. When a stroke of luck has the ability to change her future forever, a missed bus stop could mean life or death.

programme.title: Transcend
programme.desc: Maranda spent her life looking for a protector, only to find herself lost in a cycle of toxic love and betrayal. From the wreckage of abandonment to a life-altering crossroads, her survival isn't just about escaping the past, it’s about surviving herself.

programme.title: ToxiCity
programme.desc: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order. A night out leads him to Sierra, an alluring actress who quickly moves in. Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: The Loyalty Test
programme.desc: Trey Harrison is an up-and-coming internet star that has created a series exposing cheaters in orchestrated sting operations, successfully turning heartbreak into a viral spectacle. But when two participants are found murdered, Trey’s world begins to crumble and things only begin to escalate.

programme.title: Love Kills
programme.desc: In the heart of Atlanta's unpredictable dating scene, Darron is a hopeless romantic with the worst luck imaginable. Every time he believes he's found "the one," he ends up caught in another tangled web of passion, betrayal, and danger. When Darron finally meets someone who seems genuine, his past mistakes come back with a vengeance. One of his exes' jealous boyfriends discovers their hidden affair, setting off a chain of events that spirals out of control.

programme.title: Bruised 2
programme.desc: Two years after the death of her husband, Kayla Brown has rebuilt her life following the launch of her successful memoir. she is then visited by a stalker, who is hell-bent on making her pay for what she has done in order to escape her husband.

programme.title: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Jessica is the smartest girl on campus tutoring the most popular football player, Ryan. He is loved by many but he also has a few enemies. After the football team wins the championship game, Ryan decides to throw an after party at his house. When campus police find Ryan’s dead body, multiple people have a motive to want him dead. Will Jessica and her friend uncover the truth before it’s too late?

programme.title: Intrigue
programme.desc: Jessica and Darren's marriage has hit a rocky stage in their lives. When a mysterious man named Michael enters her life, Jessica is intrigued explores options that could have deadly consequences.

programme.title: Predatory Behavior
programme.desc: When women start disappearing all over the city, Detective Powell and Scott take on the case hoping to bring the culprit to justice. Can they find the elusive killer or will it be to late for the next victim.

programme.title: Queen of the Trap House
programme.desc: When Kionna is asked to step in and take control of her jailed boyfriend, Tyreek's, drug empire, she reluctantly agrees, but her new position as Queen of the Trap House suits her more than expected.

programme.title: Born Again Baddie
programme.desc: Following a tragic car accident that claimed her mother’s life and left her father paralyzed, Nia is desperate and forced into a life of crime. After expanding her business and becoming the queen pin of the city, tragedy strikes and it forces her to find solace and reflection on her past life choices.

programme.title: Legends of the Highway
programme.desc: Follow the true story of the Florida Highwaymen, 26 self-taught African American artists who forged their own path to success in the segregated 1950’s and 60’s. Their stories are guided by the mentorship of renowned landscape painters A.E. Backus, Alfred Hair, and Harold Newton. Their troupe captured Florida’s breathtaking landscapes and sold their paintings along state highways, circumventing the traditional art world that excluded them.

programme.title: Runway of Shadows
programme.desc: Sisters Ivy and Zara are separated at a very young age due to their father’s deceit. When Ivy and Zara unexpectedly cross paths at a prestigious runway show, the stage it set for a series of mysterious and unsettling events.

programme.title: Commandments of a Female Hustler
programme.desc: Three childhood friends, Lala, Binky, and Jay grew up together on the streets of East Baltimore. Wanting a better life for themselves, they learn the ways of hustling. When they align themselves with one of the most powerful drug dealers in the game, their loyalties are tested, and the very commandments that once bound them start to break.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Broken Harmony
programme.desc: Recording artist Harmony Brown, listens to every suggestion from her record label including changing her sound, changing her look, and even changing the type of music she sang. Yet, her numbers aren’t improving, and she’s on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she’s forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

programme.title: Love Kills
programme.desc: In the heart of Atlanta's unpredictable dating scene, Darron is a hopeless romantic with the worst luck imaginable. Every time he believes he's found "the one," he ends up caught in another tangled web of passion, betrayal, and danger. When Darron finally meets someone who seems genuine, his past mistakes come back with a vengeance. One of his exes' jealous boyfriends discovers their hidden affair, setting off a chain of events that spirals out of control.

programme.title: Single Forever
programme.desc: The Dawkins Brothers are back with another wild adventure! When Herc decides to retire from the porn industry, he looks to make a career change into stand-up comedy. His dreams are threatened whenever his ex-girlfriend is released from prison, and looks to take her revenge on how he did her wrong.

programme.title: Lacee
programme.desc: Four talented girls from different backgrounds form a R&B group with the intentions of being the best. They will soon find out that their dark journey consists of sex, power, and betrayal.

programme.title: Lacee: Rise 2 the Top
programme.desc: After a run in the girl group LACEE, Karin decides to step out on her own as a solo artist. As she preps for her solo debut, a former lover brings out a new artist that will compete, for the reigning spot as the new R&B diva.

programme.title: But You Love Him
programme.desc: High school sweethearts Kelvin and Lydia have been dating for over 10 years. But Lydia’s promiscuous ways will lead them down a dark path and reveal an unspoken truth that will change both of their lives.

programme.title: The Perfect Mother
programme.desc: Linda, a determined mother, faces the daily struggles of raising her son Ahmad amidst the unpredictable presence of her husband Jeremy. When a series of hardships push her to the edge, Linda's plea for assistance inadvertently leads to Ahmad being taken into CPS custody. Linda rises to the challenge of overcoming adversary to reunite her family and save her son.

programme.title: Asking for a Friend
programme.desc: A successful engineer struggles in the love department. In denial that his girlfriend is cheating on him, Jeff gets teased by his homeboys until they convince him to try this new dating app and get back out there prove his value to his girlfriend.

programme.title: Make it Rain
programme.desc: After struggling to find a job following graduation, Mone' is enticed by her best friend Lala to audition at a local strip club. She enters the seductive underworld of the strip club, experiencing financial success and personal challenges. As Mone' navigates the dark side of the industry, she must confront betrayal, addiction, tragedy, and ultimately find the strength to rebuild her life and pursue her dreams.

programme.title: Everything I Never Expected
programme.desc: Opposites attract when a spoiled bachelor and a broke college grad accidentally become roommates. Forced to cohabitate in a less-than-ideal apartment, they clash, prank, and eventually fall for each other. Life challenges and misunderstandings complicate their budding romance, but true love prevails.

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: After an argument with her emotionally abusive step-father, a smart 19-year-old woman from rural Georgia hastily moves to Atlanta with hopes of staying with a friend. Motivated by the social justice movement of 2020, she wants to work for Stacy Abrams and register people to vote. After an argument with her friend, she finds herself suddenly homeless and must survive on the mean streets of Atlanta by any means necessary.

programme.title: Bloodline of the Jewel
programme.desc: Bride to be, Nahdulay Ncala’s world is turned upside down as she finds herself in the middle of someone's dangerous and deadly quest for a royal jewel. Traveling from Africa to America, Nahdulay connects with an unsuspecting driver, Oliver, who vows to help her get answers. Nahdulay is faced with revlations from her past and newly surfaced feelings, as a series of mysterious and deadly events connected to her family unfold.

programme.title: The Loyalty Test
programme.desc: Trey Harrison is an up-and-coming internet star that has created a series exposing cheaters in orchestrated sting operations, successfully turning heartbreak into a viral spectacle. But when two participants are found murdered, Trey’s world begins to crumble and things only begin to escalate.

programme.title: Don't Miss the Bus
programme.desc: Sierra, a single mother hustles in order to survive with long shifts and grunt work. Her faith is pinned on lottery tickets and men who exploit her vulnerability. When a stroke of luck has the ability to change her future forever, a missed bus stop could mean life or death.

programme.title: We in This Together
programme.desc: Attorney August marries Daisha, a social climber more interested in his bank account than motherhood. To hide her infertility, Daisha secretly adopts 17-year-old "Lil August," sparking an immediate, violent rivalry. While August dismisses the teen’s lethal behavior as "playful," Daisha finds herself trapped in a house with a son who may be a killer. As she plots to conceive a biological heir, a series of dark secrets and "accidents" leave the family’s survival in question.

programme.title: CUT
programme.desc: Bunny is attempting to rebuild her life in Atlanta. Her financial aid suddenly falls through, until she meets Renee who shows her the ways of hustling and fast money, as well as Ed, a music producer and drug addict. Will her bad choices and mistake take her down the wrong path?

programme.title: Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث حول أكشارا ونايتيكي، اللذان يحاصرهما زواج مرتب بقوة فرض عليهما من قبل مجتمع منافق، يكافحون من أجل فهم بعضهم البعض ولكنهم يتفهمون ويدعمون ويحبون بعضهم البعض تدريجيًا.

programme.title: Seher Hone Ko Hai
programme.desc: تحلم فتاة تبلغ من العمر ستة عشر عامًا بأن تصبح طبيبة، لكنها تواجه عقبة كبيرة في شخصية والدها المتشدد الذي يرفض ذلك بسبب معتقداته الدينية الصارمة. كما تُخطَب لشاب لم تختره، بينما تقف والدتها إلى جانبها متحدية الحواجز المجتمعية لمساعدتها على تحقيق حلمها وإكمال دراستها.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: تدور قصة الفيلم حول كاران خانا، السياسي من أصل هندي في المملكة المتحدة والمتهم بقتل زوجته، والذي يحاول المحامي الخاص به تخليصه من التهمة بإثبات ارتكاب روح شريرة للجريمة.

programme.title: Parineetii
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقود القدر صديقتين مقربتين للزواج من نفس الرجل، مما يؤدي إلى العديد من الصعوبات مع ظهور مثلث حب معقد، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.desc: تدور الأحداث حول أكشارا ونايتيكي، اللذان يحاصرهما زواج مرتب بقوة فرض عليهما من قبل مجتمع منافق، يكافحون من أجل فهم بعضهم البعض ولكنهم يتفهمون ويدعمون ويحبون بعضهم البعض تدريجيًا.

programme.desc: تصبح منات طاهية موهوبة بعد أن تُركت وحيدة بعد ولادتها، لتكتشف لاحقًا أن رئيستها في العمل هي والدتها الحقيقية. تواجه منات خلال رحلتها العديد من التحديات التي تختبر أحلامها وقدرتها على الصمود في عالم مليء بالحب والحقائق الخفية، وتسعى لاكتشاف مصيرها.

programme.title: Mahnoor
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث حول (ماهنور) التي تلاحقها حقيقة ماضيها أينما ذهبت، فتجد نفسها مضطرة لمواجهة القرارات التي لا تزال تطاردها، بينما تصبح نجاتها مرهونًا بتحمل عواقب ظنت يومًا أنها قادرة على الهروب منها.

programme.title: على صدى الخلخال
programme.desc: تنطلق امرأة شابة طموحة رحلتها لتحقيق وعد قطعته على نفسها لوالدتها بحياة أفضل، لكنها تواجه صعوبات وخسائر كثيرة. تتعقد حياتها أكثر عندما تلتقي برجل يشكل تحديًا جديدًا في طريقها، مما يدفعها لمواجهة مشاعر ومواقف معقدة وهي تسعى للتغلب على محنها.

programme.title: Singh Is King
programme.desc: يعيش (هابي سينج) في قرية صغيرة بولاية البنجاب، وهو شخص متعاون وحنون على الدوام لكنه غالبا ما ينتهي به المطاف إلى التسبب في المزيد من الضرر. وعندما يكتشف الأهالي أن أحد أبناء القرية يعمل كرجل عصابات في استراليا، يقررون إرسال هابي للدفاع عنه في محاولة للتخلص منه هو الآخر. يقرر كبار القرية أيضا إرسال (رانجيلا) كمرافق لهابي في رحلته، لكنهما ينتهي بهما المطاف إلى الذهاب إلى مصر ومقابلة (سونيا) الفتاة المتخصصة في علم الجرائم التي تفضل قتل المجرمين على إصلاحهم. يتمكن (هابي) و(رانجيلا) من الوصول إلى استراليا، لكن بمجرد وصولهما يحدث سوء تفاهم ويعتقد رجال العصابة أن (هابي) رئيس العصابة الجديد.

programme.desc: تدور الأحداث حول (ماهنور) التي تلاحقها حقيقة ماضيها أينما ذهبت، فتجد نفسها مضطرة لمواجهة القرارات التي لا تزال تطاردها، بينما تصبح نجاتها مرهونًا بتحمل عواقب ظنت يومًا أنها قادرة على الهروب منها.

programme.title: Animal
programme.desc: (جيمس أنيمال) رجل عصابات ينتهي به الأمر محبوسا في السجن، وخلال قضائه لفترة عقوبته، يلتقي بعجوز ثوري يقوم بتوجيه اهتمامه نحو عالم كتابات (مالكوم إكس) ليستنتج منها أن شعبه يتم التلاعب به من قبل قوى عليا لكي يقتل بعضه البعض، وبعد إطلاق سراح (جيمس) يعود إلى منزله ليكتشف أن ابنه توغل في عالم الجريمة رغبة منه لاستكمال مسيرة والده، ويحاول (جيمس) بشتى الطرق إقناع ابنه بالابتعاد عن العصابات الخطيرة.

programme.desc: The hosts present a compilation of the latest updates and developments pertaining to politics, sports, social and economic news.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता राजनीति, खेल, सामाजिक और आर्थिक जगत से संबंधित नवीनतम समाचारों और घटनाक्रमों का संकलन प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
அன்றைய சமூக, பொருளாதார-அரசியல் பிரச்சினைகள் மற்றும் தற்போதைய நிகழ்வுகள் பற்றிய புதுப்பிப்புகளை வழங்கும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఈనాటి సామాజిక, ఆర్థిక, రాజకీయ సమస్యల గురించి సమాచారాన్ని, ప్రస్తుత సంఘటనలకు సంబంధించిన విశేషాలను అందిస్తారు.
प्रस्तुतकर्ते दिवसभराच्या सामाजिक, अर्थविषयक आणि राजकीय विषयांवर आधारित ताज्या घडामोडी आणि माहिती सादर करतात.

programme.title: Real America With Dan Ball
programme.desc: Dan Ball brings the political headlines by interviewing newsmakers of the day, including politicians, lawmakers, pundits, celebrities and social media influencers.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Pudding's Determination! Ablaze! The Seducing Woods!
programme.desc: Kingbaum puts his life on the line ferrying the Straw Hats towards the Seducing Woods! But Big Mom's word trumps him in this terrifying forest, and soon enough she catches up! Meanwhile, Pudding puts her plan to rebuild the cake into action!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Lightning Counterattack! Nami and Zeus the Thundercloud!
programme.desc: Zeus pursues the Straw Hats as Nami keeps him occupied. She has a shocking surprise in store for him, however, that might stop Big Mom in her tracks! Meanwhile, Brook and Chopper find the Shark Submerge in a strange situation.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Coincidental Reunion! Sanji and the Lovestruck Evil Pudding!
programme.desc: Big Mom is relentless in her pursuit of the Straw Hats! Even being buried alive doesn't stop her! The plan to recreate the cake to stop her onslaught progresses, and Pudding's changeable heart confuses all those looking on!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Save the Sunny! Fighting Bravely! Chopper and Brook!
programme.desc: Mama's onslaught continues as Pudding keeps battling the contradictory urges in her head - to kill or kiss Sanji! Meanwhile, Brook and Chopper are at Perospero's mercy - and are being reduced to sweetened versions of themselves!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Before the Dawn! Pedro, the Captain of the Guardians!
programme.desc: Sandwiched between Big Mom and her advancing fleet, the only hope is the Sunny's Coup-de-Burst! But can the Straw Hats prepare it in time? Meanwhile, Pedro comes face to face with his past.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: I'll Be Back! Luffy, Deadly Departure
programme.desc: The last chance the Straw Hats have is the Coup de Burst! Pedro has made the ultimate sacrifice to give them this one chance to escape, but Big Mom's naval forces are closing in and poised to knock them out!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Man with a Bounty of Billion! The Strongest Sweet General, Katakuri!
programme.desc: Nami and the others who escaped the Whole Cake Island by Pedro's sacrifice mourn over his death. Jimbei, however, keeps his calm, which makes Brook lose his temper. Meanwhile, Luffy confronts the formidable Sweet General Katakuri in the Mirroworld.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Hard Battle Starts! Luffy vs. Katakuri!
programme.desc: Pudding and Sanji arrive at Cacao Island and begin to remake the only cake that will calm Big Mom! But their fake nuptials get in the way as they bicker like a married couple! Meanwhile, Luffy has lost the battle of his life.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Green Room! An Invincible Helmsman, Jimbei!
programme.desc: Luffy keeps the forces out to destroy the Straw Hats at bay, however the crew needs to destroy all the mirrors - the final link that secure his safe return - on the ship in order to save themselves!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Threat of the Mole! Luffy’s Silent Fight!
programme.desc: Nami and the others start breaking all the mirrors on the Sunny in order to keep their enemies out while she and Luffy discuss where to rendezvous – but little do they know the plan is overheard!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The End of the Deadly Battle?! Katakuri's Awakening in Anger!
programme.desc: Both powerful combatants and strong users of Haki, Luffy and Katakuri are a dead match for each other. Every move is matched by their opponent! Elsewhere, the Big Mom Pirates square off against Germa!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Katakuri retires to his sanctuary to enjoy the merienda - a chance for him to savor the sweetness of his crew of chefs and replenish his Haki!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luffy Fights Back! The Invincible Katakuri's Weak Point!
programme.desc: Luffy discovers the secret to Katakuri's unearthly fighting ability, and just might have a solution for how to stop him! Meanwhile, at the Sweets Factory, Pudding receives a call from Brulee who has bad news for the Straw Hats!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Another Crisis! Gear Four vs. Unstoppable Donuts!
programme.desc: Luffy runs out of his Haki and has to buy some time - in the most peculiar way! Meanwhile the Big Mom Pirates mobilize their entire fleet to squelch the pirate threat, and the replacement cake nears completion!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Rebellious Daughter, Chiffon! Sanji's Big Plan for Transporting the Cake!
programme.desc: When Chiffon comes under attack, Sanji must choose between defending her or revealing himself to his enemies! Meanwhile, Luffy uses Brulee as a human shield to avoid the wrath of Big Mom!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Man's Way of Life! Bege and Luffy's Determination as Captains!
programme.desc: Bege arrives on the scene, seemingly willing to risk it all to bring down the Big Mom Pirates in a blaze of glory, but of course he has a trick up his sleeve! Meanwhile, Luffy keeps on the move to regain his Haki!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Cake Sank?! Sanji and Bege's Getaway Battle!
programme.desc: Sanji and Bege get together and get off of Cacao Island successfully, but their plan is in jeopardy as Oven begins to boil the sea itself! As Chiffon and the others who are on the ship are cornered, a surprising savior comes in to fight Oven!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A vicious pincer attack bears down on the Straw Hats! Three fleets converge and try to squeeze the life from them! Daifuku himself take the lead! But Carrot draws on a deep power within and springs in to action under the light of the moon!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Break Through! The Straw Hat's Mighty Sea Battle!
programme.desc: The much anticipated wedding cake is on its way, but there is a debate at the last minute! Shouldn't this opportunity be used to slip poison into Big Mom's meal to topple the Emperor of the Sea?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Finally, They Clash! The Emperor of the Sea vs. the Straw Hats!
programme.desc: Luffy, through sheer force of will, can almost use his Haki to battle Katakuri! Meanwhile, the Sunny catches fire while the Straw Hats try to kick out Big Mom, but that's when Jimbei steps up to the plate and takes a swing at her!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Dark King's Direct Precepts! The Battle Against Katakuri Turns Around!
programme.desc: Luffy tries to enhance his Haki to foresee Katakuri's next move, but Katakuri's attacks keep pulling him down!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Finally He Returns! Sanji, the Man Who'll Stop the Emperor of the Sea!
programme.desc: The cake is finally prepared and brought before Big Mom! With the end of her vicious rampage in sight, there is a chance for the Straw Hats to flee! Big Mom's crew is forced to decide who to attack! Meanwhile, Luffy grows ever closer to using his Haki!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Lurking in the Darkness! An Assassin Targeting Luffy!
programme.desc: Hiding her presence, Flampe shoots her blowgun at Luffy to support her dear brother Katakuri. Meanwhile, Oven launches a dastardly plan to fence Luffy in - by destroying every mirror on the island!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: One Man's Determination! Katakuri's Deadly Big Fight!
programme.desc: Katakuri notices his sister Flampe is sneakily providing poison needle back up in the shadows. Becoming enraged, he takes unexpected action that surprises everyone. Meanwhile, Smoothie increases her size and closes in on the Sunny.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Wake Up! The Color of Observation Able to Top the Strongest!
programme.desc: Luffy leans on his training to bring out the power of his Haki! Meanwhile, the children of Big Mom gather as a massive force, ready to smash Luffy and the Straw Hats. Their resentment at being embarrassed fuels their desire to get revenge!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Fist of Divine Speed! Another Gear Four Application Activated!
programme.desc: Luffy and Katakuri are locked in a duel to end all duels! Their powers ensure that each blow could be the last! Luffy must rely on his training, let all his thoughts out, and keep pushing on! Meanwhile, Sanji is about to land at Cacao Island!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Finally, It's Over! The Climax of the Intense Fight against Katakuri!
programme.desc: Luffy's dramatic battle finally draws to a close! But even if he is able to pull out victory in the last moment, can he remember the key to escaping the Mirrorworld?!

programme.title: Harlequin: This Matter of Marriage
programme.desc: Arkitekterne Hallie og Donnalee arbejder på et stort byggeprojekt for en excentrisk milliardær, Adam Barr. Hallie, der har ledt efter sin drømmeprins, finder ham pludselig lige ved siden af. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Hard to Forget
programme.desc: Privatdetektiv Max er overbevist om, at Sandra død ikke var et uheld, men at hendes mand John myrdede hende. Da han møder Sandras tvillingesøster Nicky, får han hende til at hjælpe sig med en plan. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Diamond Girl
programme.desc: Playboy-advokaten Denny kaster aldrig et blik på sin kedelige, men loyale assistent Claire . Men da han opdager, at hun er en usleben diamant, beslutter han sig for at forvandle hende til en skønhed. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Waiting Game
programme.desc: Sarah og Amy, der har været bedste venner siden college, arrangerer deres første kunstudstilling i en lille by i New England. Da mystiske fremmede træder ind i deres forsigtige liv og udfolder sig et mysterium.Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster

programme.title: Harlequin: Loving Evangeline
programme.desc: Da Robert får at vide, at hans bror er omkommet i en bådulykke, tager han af sted for at hente liget og møder Evie Shaw. Han bliver besat af sin brors mistænkelige død... og af Evie. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Recipe for Revenge
programme.desc: Cateringfirmaet Carly Westin indvilliger i at tilberede et festmåltid for en veninde. Men parret bliver myrdet, mens hun er i køkkenet. Da politiefterforsker Jack bliver involveret, må han beskytte Carly. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: Da den urolige tvilling Dominique beder sin boglige søster Kimberly om at overtage hendes rolle som glamourøs parisisk model i en måned, tøver Kimberly. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: Da Lisa vågner op på hospitalet, kan hun ikke huske noget: Hun kan ikke huske, hvem hun er, at hendes mand ønsker at lade sig skilles. Da hendes mand tager hende med hjem, må Lisa lære alting forfra. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: People Are Alike All Over
programme.desc: When a space exploration crashes on Mars, the surviving passenger is surprised to find that Martians are human-looking, very friendly and apparently just like us...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Execution
programme.desc: Just before being hanged for shooting a man in the back, a man in 1880 is transported into the year 1959 by a professor who soon realizes that he has brought forward a savage killer.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Big Tall Wish
programme.desc: An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Nice Place to Visit
programme.desc: After being shot to death, Rocky Valentine encounters the amiable white-haired Mr. Pip, who gives Rocky everything he wishes for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare as a Child
programme.desc: Schoolteacher Helen Foley finds a strange and very serious little girl on the stairs outside her apartment. The little girl seems to know her and tries to jog her memory about a man she saw earlier that day. The man arrives at Helen's door…

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Stop at Willoughby
programme.desc: Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Chaser
programme.desc: A man, desperate to win the affection of a beautiful woman, slips her a love potion. He is overjoyed that the potion works so well...at first.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Passage for Trumpet
programme.desc: A trumpet player who's convinced he'll never amount to anything attempts suicide and finds himself in a world where no one can hear or see him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Bevis
programme.desc: An eccentric loser gets a new life from his guardian angel, but there is a price to keeping it.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours
programme.desc: A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mighty Casey
programme.desc: A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: King Nine Will Not Return
programme.desc: A pilot of a downed WW II bomber comes to in the African desert and desperately tries to find out what happened to the rest of his crew.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Man in the Bottle
programme.desc: A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programme.sub-title: Nervous Man in a Four Dollar Room
programme.desc: Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Thing About Machines
programme.desc: Bartlett Finchley's paranoia about the machines around proves true.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Howling Man
programme.desc: Seeking refuge from a storm, traveler David Ellington comes upon a bizarre hermitage of monks, who have imprisoned a man who begs for his help. When David confronts the head monk Brother Jerome, he is told that the man is the devil, and David must decide

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: A young woman lying in a hospital bed, her head wrapped in bandages, awaits the outcome of a surgical procedure performed by the State in a last-ditch attempt to make her look 'normal'.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Lateness of the Hour
programme.desc: The daughter of an inventor objects to their 'perfect' home where they are waited on by mechanical servants.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trouble with Templeton
programme.desc: A nostalgic actor revisits his late wife and friends at their old haunt, only to find that he is now out of place there.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Most Unusual Camera
programme.desc: When three dum-dum crooks get ahold of a camera that takes pictures of the future, they set out to make a quick fortune with their new toy.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Night of the Meek
programme.desc: After a derelict Santa Claus is fired on Christmas Eve, he finds a mysterious bag that gives out presents. With this bag, he sets out to fulfill his one wish - to see the less fortunate inherit the bounties of Christmas.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dust
programme.desc: In a tragic, western town, a desperate father begs for clemency as his son is slated to die for an accident he could not have prevented.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Back There
programme.desc: At a prominent club in Washington, D.C., a socialite argues about whether it would be possible to change history by traveling back in time. When he leaves the club he finds himself in 1865, on the night that President Lincoln will be shot.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Whole Truth
programme.desc: A used car salesman buys a car that dooms him to tell only the truth.

programme.title: Nightwatch
programme.desc: En pengestærk jurastuderende tjener nemme penge som nattevagt i byens lighus. Men hans fredelige kirkegårdsvagter bliver en rædsel, da en seriemorder begynder at skabe kaos og efterlader spor, der peger på Martin!

programme.title: The Prophecy: Forsaken
programme.desc: Den episke PROPHECY-saga ender med dette elektriske femte og endelige afsnit, THE PROPHECY: FORSAKEN. Da en fortidig bog om profetier forudsiger Antikrists ankomst, igangsætter en gruppe af faldne engle en nådesløs jagt for at finde den.

programme.title: MEN
programme.desc: A young woman goes on a solo vacation to the English countryside following the death of her ex-husband.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Killer Shrews
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark.

programme.title: Homebound
programme.desc: A trip to the countryside turns out to be far from idyllic for a father and his new fiancée when his kids decide the house is a little too crowded.

programme.title: Pay The Ghost
programme.desc: A professor frantically searches for his son who was abducted during a Halloween carnival.

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: Based on the terrifying true story, firearm heiress Sarah Winchester believes she is haunted by the souls of people killed by the Winchester repeating rifle, leading her to build a never-ending mansion to house the tortured souls of the dead.

programme.title: Homebound
programme.desc: A trip to the countryside turns out to be far from idyllic for a father and his new fiancée when his kids decide the house is a little too crowded.

programme.title: Pay The Ghost

programme.title: The Net
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock, Dennis Miller and Jeremy Northam star in this hit thriller about a computer expert whose life is "erased" by a computer conspiracy. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Premonition
programme.desc: Linda Hanson (Sandra Bullock) has a beautiful house, a loving husband and two adorable daughters. Her life is perfect, until the day she gets the devastating news that her husband Jim (Julian McMahon) has died in a car accident. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: While You Were Sleeping
programme.desc: Lucy becomes smitten with a handsome stranger.

programme.title: The Thing Called Love
programme.desc: In Nashville, there are 10,000 singer-songwriters chasing success... with one chance in a million of getting it. For Miranda "no relation to Elvis" Presley, that's one chance worth taking.

programme.title: Forces of Nature
programme.desc: Ben is trying to get to Savannah for his wedding. A seagull flies into the engine as the plane is taking off. All later flights are canceled because of an approaching hurricane, so he hitches a ride in with an attractive woman named Sara.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: On a seemingly routine spacewalk, disaster strikes, leaving two astronauts completely alone. As the deafening silence tells them they have lost any link to Earth, the only way home may be to go further into the terrifying expanse of space.

programme.title: Three Faces West
programme.desc: A Viennese physician and his daughter, refugees from Hitler, become part of a group of North Dakota townspeople planning to relocate from the dust bowl to greener Oregon.

programme.title: Island In The Sky
programme.desc: Filmen foregår efter anden verdenskrig, og John Wayne spiller Dooley, en tidligere militærpilot, der flyver fragtfly og bliver tvunget til at foretage en nødlanding på en frossen sø, fordi han løber tør for brændstof, og flyet kommer ud af kurs.

programme.title: Flying Tigers
programme.desc: John Wayne adds luster to this early WWII film about the famous P-40 Flying Group who soared into battle against the Japanese in defense of China's freedom, Great dogfight scenes!

programme.title: Westward Ho
programme.desc: A young boy sees his parents killed and his brother kidnapped by outlaws, while traveling west on a wagon train. As an adult, he leads a vigilante band seeking the outlaw band, even though his brother is now their scout.

programme.title: Rio Lobo
programme.desc: Det femte och sista samarbetet mellan John Wayne och regissör Howard Hawks är en actionfylld westernfilm som utspelar sig efter inbördeskriget. En grupp män är på jakt efter några unionsförrädare som är skyldiga till en serie tågrån.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: John Wayne plays Hondo Lane, a cavalry rider who becomes the protector of Angie Lowe as well as a father figure to her boy, Johnny. Angie, determinedly awaiting the return of her husband, refuses to leave their homestead despite the growing danger.

programme.title: Red River Range
programme.desc: The cattlemen's organization calls upon the Three Mesquiteers to pose as outlaws to round up cattle thieves who cleverly cover their tracks and vanish.

programme.title: Flame Of Barbary Coast
programme.desc: A cowboy competes with a gambling tycoon on the Barbary Coast for the hand of a beautiful dance-hall queen.

programme.title: P.S.
programme.desc: En nyligen skild kvinna får chansen att återuppleva sitt förflutna när hon träffar en ung man som verkar vara hennes gymnasiekärlek, som dog många år tidigare.

programme.title: Surviving Christmas with the Relatives
programme.desc: Två systrar med sina familjer samlas för att fira jul i systrarnas nyligen avlidna föräldrars fallfärdiga hus ute på landet – och det slutar i kaos. Gammal syskonrivalitet blossar snart upp och hotar den glada julstämningen i den här tokroliga komedin.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: Disaster movie' följer de komiska missödena av några sjukt snygga 20-åringar under en ödesdiger natt då de försöker att komma i säkerhet undan alla naturkatastrofer som finns.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En erfaren lönnmördare får problem när han blir kär i sitt mål, en charmig svindlare som inte tänker gå ner utan en fight.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady har bott i Afrika och vet inte hur 'vilt' det kan vara i civilisationen förrän hon möter en av världens elakaste arter, 'bidrottningen', som på den här skolan är den coola och beräknande Regina George.

programme.title: L.A. Gigolo
programme.desc: en unga och charmerande Nicki (Ashton Kutcher) lever ett liv som enbart de snyggaste kan drömma om. Han svindlar till sig en luxuös livsstil genom att tillfredställa rika kvinnor i sängen – och han är djävulskt bra på det!

programme.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
programme.desc: Emma sitter på ett plan som hon tror är på väg att störta. Hon berättar därför alla sina hemligheter för en snygg främling. Åtminstone tror hon att han är en främling...tills hon träffar Jack, hennes företags nya vd. Baserad på romanen med samma namn.

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: Den "svarta får"-sonen av en förmögen familj möter en ung psykiatrisk patient som har växt upp i isolering hela sitt liv. Han tar med sig denna naiva unga kvinna hem till sin brors bröllop.

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: Da Jack Deebs satt i fengsel skapte han Cool World, en tegneserie om hespetreet Holli Would. Men blod er tynnere enn blekk når Holli tar menneskelig form i Las Vegas.

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: Ett blikk, og du vet at de er fra et veldig rart sted. De er fra New Jersey, via "Frankrike", via Remulak langt ute på viddene. De er Coneheads.

programme.title: Barbarella
programme.desc: Settingen er planeten Lythion i år 40 000, der Barbarella må nødlande mens hun reiser gjennom verdensrommet. Hun beseirer det onde i form av roboter og monstre. Hun belønner også de kjekke mennene som ledsager henne på eventyrene.

programme.title: Notorious
programme.desc: Datteren til en dømt nazispion blir bedt av amerikanske agenter om å samle informasjon om en ring av nazistiske forskere i Sør-Amerika. Hvor langt må hun gå for å infiltrere dem?

programme.title: Wagons East
programme.desc: De var ute etter gull, men nå tar de til takke med innlagt vann. John Candy og Richard Lewis spiller i dette hysterisk ukonvensjonelle blikket på den legendariske ville vesten.

programme.title: Easy Come, Easy Go
programme.desc: On his last day in the Navy, frogman Elvis discovers a sunken treasure ship. On his first day as a civilian, Elvis starts his new job—self-employed treasure hunter!

programme.title: Uncommon Valor
programme.desc: Gene Hackman spiller oberst Jason Rhodes, en mann som er besatt, i dette kraftfulle, actionfylte eventyret.

programme.title: Blue Chips
programme.desc: Pete Bell, en college-baskettrener, er under mye press. Laget hans vinner ikke. Fremtidens stjerner blir betalt av andre lag. Denne praksisen er forbudt i college-spillet, men Pete er desperat og har press fra alle sider.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Chemtrails
programme.desc: What on Earth are they spraying? Richard travels into the field to meet several researchers who present compelling evidence that chemicals or biological agents are being deliberately sprayed into the atmosphere by some shadowy government agency.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Antichrist
programme.desc: End times prophecy experts discuss the possible identity of the antichrist and the timing of his emergence onto the world state.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Electronic Harassment
programme.desc: Two victims of alleged electronic harassment and organized gang-stalking recount their horrible ordeals. Richard investigates possible theories as to who is behind this program and why.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Demonic Possession
programme.desc: The religious practice known as exorcism is examined as well as claims of demonic possession. Richard travels to a Catholic seminary in Yonkers, New York.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Is a powerfully rich cabal with a globalist agenda conspiring to destroy sovereign nations and impose authoritarian rule?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Bulkeley Hotel
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Plas Teg

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Block
programme.desc: The team investigate a disused factory in Burton-Upon-Trent. Reports of paranormal happenings are common and the team are ready for anything.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Trapped and Retreat
programme.desc: Paranormal activity threatens a young nurse caring for a catatonic patient. A young couple falls prey to a demonic presence in a remote cabin.

programme.title: Imparable
programme.desc: Dong-Chul fue un gánster legendario, pero está intentando llevar una vida honesta y pacífica dentro de la legalidad. Sin embargo, todo cambia cuando su esposa, Ji-soo, es secuestrada por una banda de tráfico de mujeres. Así que Dong-Chul no verá otra salida que volver a sus antiguos métodos para poder encontrarla.

programme.title: Operación Lobo
programme.desc: Adaptación cinematográfica de la exitosa serie de Netflix en una superproducción cargada de acción trepidante. Una unidad policial se enfrenta al peligro y la tragedia en la noche en que los héroes de las Fuerzas Especiales turcas arriesgaron todo para evitar un golpe de estado.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Un equipo de letales mercenarios son contratados estratégicamente por el multimillonario CEO de tecnología Donovan Chalmers (Bruce Willis) para proteger una pieza de tecnología que, si se expone, podría destruir el mundo. Su misión se convierte en un riesgo aún mayor cuando la hija de Chalmers es secuestrada por el peligroso grupo terrorista The Pardoners.

programme.title: El último día en la Tierra
programme.desc: La luna roja amenaza la existencia de la humanidad al dirigirse hacia la Tierra. La única esperanza es Paul W.R., un astronauta brillante encargado de destruirla, pero este se niega y desaparece antes de la misión. Junto a Elma, una adolescente impulsiva, huye mientras es perseguido por las autoridades, con la destrucción del planeta cada vez más cerca.

programme.title: El Mundo Es Tuyo - Temporada 2
programme.desc: Comenzamos nuestro viaje en Cantabria, España, para explorar las cuevas de Altamira, donde se encuentra uno de los yacimientos más antiguos de la humanidad, y nos comeremos un cocido montañés. Después, pondremos rumbo a Jerusalén.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: Dos extraños se encuentran con la mina de oro más grande jamás encontrada cuando viajan por el interior del desierto australiano. La codicia por alcanzar el sueño de ser millonarios se apodera de ellos y rápidamente traman un plan para proteger, excavar y extraer todo el oro posible antes de que el duro clima y los peligros propios de la sabana australiana acaben con sus vidas.
